question: What does ‘p’ in pH stand for?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Potenz__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Potenz is the known with the English translation as** Power, Potency, **etc.
 
• It was been described by the **German scholar Potenz**.
 
• It is mainly used for the measure of the concentration of the** pH scale** and the** hydrogen**.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Potential __is the english word for the Capacity. It is the necessary abilities or the qualities to be or to do something. In the terms of Chemistry, is the capabilty that a substance hold all within itself.
 
• __Pleural,__ is mainly for the plueral space or the plueral capacity between the plueral sac that surrounds each lung.
 
• __Potencial __is again which holds its meaning with the capacity to do something. The actual capability a substance hold within itself all around.
